_description: Du lieu THAM CHIEU dinh danh lo chuyen cho Tang 3: ma chuyen (shipment_id), lenh dieu dong (transfer_order_no), so hoa don va alias giua cac ma CU THE. Toan bo gia tri duoc suy ra tu 72 anh demo trong 'Copy of HUONG DAN CHUNG TU GIAO NHAN.xlsx' va output/stage3_gt.json - KHONG phai luat nghiep vu tong quat.
_warning: Chi so Tang 3 do CO file nay KHONG phai uoc luong kha nang tong quat hoa: file duoc suy tu chinh bo anh dung de cham diem. Khi trien khai that PHAI thay bang danh muc chuyen xe / lenh dieu dong / hoa don xuat tu ERP/SAP cua khach hang (cung dinh dang). Khong co file -> stage3_resolver chay KHONG hieu chinh (reference_loaded=false trong metadata manifest) va chi so phan anh nang luc that.
_precedent: AGENTS.md muc 9.2 - config/stage2_shipment_reference.json (bang 12 ma chuyen Tang 2).
